issues.quote: organ in Platyhelminthes and organ system in the others
issues.problem: This wording places Ctenophora at the organ-system level. NCERT puts ctenophores, like cnidarians, at the tissue level of organisation. The notes also list Ctenophora as diploblastic in the same paragraph, so the error stands out.
issues.correction: Level of organisation: cellular in Porifera; tissue in Cnidaria and Ctenophora; organ in Platyhelminthes; organ system from Aschelminthes onwards.
